stories.title: Army's lead azide detonation in Iowa: Timing, latest exposure map and more
stories.summary: The U.S. Army plans to detonate the nation’s entire stockpile of lead azide Wednesday morning in Iowa . The move comes after officials warned the dangerously degrading bomb-making chemicals could otherwise explode at any time. “Inaction is no longer an option,” said Maj. Gen. Eri
